title: TRICARE Premium-Based Plans: Plan Design and Coverage Type by Tier
content:
The **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans** are sold in six tiers. Each tier fixes who the purchase covers and how care is organised under it: a Select-type design has no primary care manager (PCM) and no referrals, while a Prime-type design carries a PCM and referrals.

## Comparison by tier

| Tier | Coverage type | Covers the purchaser's DEERS-eligible family members | Plan design | PCM assigned | Specialty care needs a PCM referral | Point-of-service charges apply to unreferred care |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only | member only | no | Select-type | no | no | no |
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family | member and family | yes | Select-type | no | no | no |
| TRICARE Young Adult Select | young adult, individual | no | Select-type | no | no | no |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only | member only | no | Select-type | no | no | no |
| TRICARE Young Adult Prime | young adult, individual | no | Prime-type | yes | yes | yes |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family | member and family | yes | Select-type | no | no | no |

Each tier applies only its own row.

## Reading the table

- **Coverage type.** Member only covers the purchaser alone; member and family also covers the purchaser's family members who are eligible in DEERS; young adult, individual covers the young adult purchaser alone.
- **Plan design.** Five tiers are Select-type. TRICARE Young Adult Prime is the only Prime-type tier, and it is the only tier with a PCM assigned, specialty referrals required and point-of-service charges for unreferred care.

## Points of judgement

- *Does a TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family purchaser have a PCM?* No - the tier is Select-type and its row shows no PCM assigned.
- *Under which tier do point-of-service charges apply to care received without a referral?* Only TRICARE Young Adult Prime.
- *Does TRICARE Young Adult Select cover a spouse or child of the young adult?* No - its coverage type is young adult, individual and it does not cover family members.
